content.heroTitle: Bringing Indonesia's Finest Natural Products to the Global Market
content.heroDesc: A trusted export partner based in Makassar & Maros, delivering premium Indonesian food products in large-scale shipments across Southeast Asia, Australia, and beyond.
content.aboutUsFirstDesc: We are an Indonesia-based export company specializing in high-quality natural and processed food products. Operating from Makassar City and Maros Regency, we connect Indonesia's rich natural resources with international markets.
content.aboutUsSecondDesc: With strong local sourcing networks and scalable production capabilities, we are ready to fulfill bulk orders ranging from multi-ton shipments to full truckload exports.

whyWithUs.title: Why Partner With Us?
whyWithUs.firstPointDesc: Capable of fulfilling bulk orders, including multi-ton and full truckload shipments.
whyWithUs.secondPointDesc: Based in Eastern Indonesia, giving efficient access to domestic sourcing and international ports.
whyWithUs.thirdPointDesc: Carefully selected raw materials and consistent quality control standards.
whyWithUs.fourthPointDesc: Experienced in serving Southeast Asian and Australian markets, with expansion plans to Europe.

product.title: Our Premium Products
product.desc: Sourced from Indonesia's rich natural resources and processed to meet international standards.

firstProduct.name: Palm Sugar Powder
firstProduct.description: Naturally derived from Indonesian palm sap, our palm sugar powder offers a rich caramel flavor and fine texture. Ideal for food manufacturers, beverage producers, and retail distribution.
firstProduct.ingredients: 100% natural palm sap (nira aren). No artificial additives, preservatives, or coloring.
firstProduct.shelfLife: 12 months from production date when stored in a cool, dry place in sealed packaging.
firstProduct.benefits: Supports immune system function; Helps maintain healthy blood sugar levels when consumed as part of a balanced diet; Promotes digestive health; Supports normal nervous system function; Naturally rich in antioxidants
firstProduct.uses: Beverage manufacturing (coffee, tea, juice, and specialty drinks); Bakery and dessert production (ingredient and topping); Culinary applications, including sauces, marinades, and seasoning blends
firstProduct.legality: Produced in accordance with Indonesian food safety regulations. Certified Halal and equipped with Indonesian Home Industry Food Production Permit (P-IRT) licensing, complete with Nutrition Facts labeling and retail barcode registration to support domestic and international distribution.

secondProduct.name: Premium Shredded Tuna
secondProduct.description: Made from carefully selected tuna, processed hygienically to preserve freshness and flavor. A high-protein product suitable for retail and wholesale distribution.
secondProduct.ingredients: Fresh Tuna, Vegetable Oil, Garlic, Shallots, Galangal, Ginger, Turmeric, Coriander, Pepper, Flavor Enhancer, Salt.
secondProduct.shelfLife: 12 months in sealed packaging when stored in a cool, dry place. Refer to label for exact expiry.
secondProduct.benefits: High protein content; source of omega-3; long shelf life; versatile for meals and snacks; suitable for retail and food service.
secondProduct.uses: Topping for rice and porridge; filling for bread and pastries; ready-to-eat snack; ingredient for traditional and modern dishes; bulk supply for repackaging.
secondProduct.legality: Produced in accordance with Indonesian food safety regulations. Certified Halal and compliant with national quality standards (SNI), equipped with Indonesian Home Industry Food Production Permit (P-IRT) licensing and retail barcode registration to support domestic and international distribution.

thirdProduct.name: Mackerel Fish Crackers
thirdProduct.description: A traditional Indonesian snack made from premium mackerel fish, offering a crispy texture and savory taste loved across markets.
thirdProduct.ingredients: Fresh Mackerel fish (tenggiri), Wheat Flour, Eggs, Pepper, Salt, Sugar, Leavening Agent.
thirdProduct.shelfLife: 3 months in sealed packaging. Store in a cool, dry place. Best consumed within stated expiry date.
thirdProduct.benefits: Everyday snack favorite; Authentic regional specialty; Versatile meal companion; Suitable for events and hospitality; Long-lasting and travel-friendly
thirdProduct.uses: Standalone snack; accompaniment to meals; retail and bulk export; custom packaging and private label; convenience and grocery distribution.
thirdProduct.legality: Produced in accordance with Indonesian food safety regulations. Certified Halal and compliant with national quality standards (SNI), equipped with Indonesian Home Industry Food Production Permit (P-IRT) licensing and retail barcode registration to support domestic and international distribution.

fourthProduct.name: Passion Fruit Beverage
fourthProduct.description: Made from fresh Indonesian passion fruit, delivering a refreshing tropical taste. Available for bulk export and private labeling.
fourthProduct.ingredients: Passion Fruit Juice, Sugar and Sodium Benzoate (as permitted preservative)
fourthProduct.shelfLife: 6 months unopened when stored in a cool, dry place. Refrigerate after opening and consume within the period stated on label.
fourthProduct.benefits: Rich in vitamin C to support normal immune function; Contains antioxidants that help protect cells from oxidative stress; A source of dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion; Contains potassium, which contributes to the maintenance of normal blood pressure; Naturally contains alkaloid compounds associated with mild calming properties
fourthProduct.uses: Ready-to-drink beverage; base for cocktails and mocktails; food service and hospitality; retail and e-commerce; bulk and container shipment for overseas bottling.
fourthProduct.legality: Halal-certified and officially registered with BPOM (Indonesia’s National Agency of Drug and Food Control), ensuring compliance with national food safety regulations.
